name: Astral-Gibber
description: From orbit the planet is a painted oval, serene; up close it is violence given volume. Hurricane cells wider than moons chase each other along the shear lines, and the lightning never quite stops.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
Nothing about the temporal distortion zone appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
